definitions.name: Even
definitions.declaration: obj Even = <value: int> where is_even(x) L1
definitions.demonstrates: An even-only refinement rejects odd inputs.

definitions.name: bump_even
definitions.declaration: op bump_even(arg0: Even) -> Even = advance(arg0) L1
definitions.demonstrates: Construction and unboxing preserve the refined type.

definitions.name: twice
definitions.declaration: comb @twice[f: A -> A](x: A) -> A = f(f(x)) L1
